item.title: Upgrading
item.description:
This page lists the actions required when upgrading stageset-controller. Each release that needs action gets a section below, headed by its calendar version; a release with no section needs no migration — a plain upgrade (bump the chart’s appVersion or pull the new image tag) suffices.

After 2026.11.23060648

A stages.metio.wtf/promote token now applies only to a stage that is held at its promotion gate for the revision being rolled out. A token stamped on a stage that already cleared its gate, that the rollout has not reached yet, or that failed is ignored, recorded on status.stages[].ignoredPromotion, and reported as a PromotionIgnored Warning Event. Such a token used to stay armed and promote the next revision of that stage past its soak, analysis, restart, event and manual gates the moment it arrived.
